text:
sam: quick Q — where are we saving ACME gen route 5xx/429 filters? trying to build a little dashboard for APAC incidents

maria: use the LogSearch view: https://console.redwood.ai/logs?view=acme-gen-route — i dropped a snippet below, paste into the query editor and save it if it looks right

maria: ```
org:acme model:gen-v2 route:generate region:ap-sg status:[500,502,503,504,429]
| where timestamp >= now() - 24h
| stats count() by status, route, model
| sort -count
```

alex: can we save that as a saved search and pin to eng-sre? name suggestion: acme-gen-route-errors-24h

maria: done — saved as acme-gen-route-errors-24h and added to shared collection `eng-sre/log-presets` (link: https://console.redwood.ai/saved/acme-gen-route-errors-24h)

jen: for alert tuning — propose alert when error_rate > 0.75% over 5m AND p95 latency > 800ms. keeps noise down but catches regressions

pranav: i'll create the alert. quick metric-style snippet you can paste into the alert UI:

pranav: ```
# compute error rate over a 5 minute window
errors = count(status >= 500 or status == 429)
total = count(*)
error_rate = errors / total * 100
window(5m)
alert if error_rate > 0.75
```

ops-bot: saved-search created by maria (maria) — id: ss-983211

sam: perfect — also where are traces for these requests? want to link from the dashboard rows to traces

maria: traces live in APM: https://console.redwood.ai/traces?service=gen-inference&env=prod&filter=org%3Aacme — when you click a log row use the trace_id field to open the span view

sam: got it, thanks :raised_hands:

alex: fyi i added the saved search to the ops runbook under "acme incident playbook" so oncall can find it

maria: permission note — shared collection is readable by eng-sre and eng-platform, ping me if you need write access

sam: will do, thanks everyone :)
